messages.author: Surajit Kalita
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I was looking for the inbuilt forcefield library of *TIP4P/Ice* water model
in AMBER simulation package. However, I am unable to find it in the AMBER
manual as well as the solvent library files. If I have missed something
during my search, I would really appreciate your effort to point me in the
right direction. *In any case, if it is not available (built-in) in AMBER,
I would be grateful if someone could suggest a way to use this force field
(TIP4P/Ice) in AMBER simulation.* Looking forward with much anticipation.
Many thanks in advance.
Kind regards,
Surajit
Hebrew University of Jerusalem
